jobDescription:
Position Summary The Peoplesoft Administrator will be responsible for helping to support, analyze and develop business solutions. The candidate must demonstrate the ability to work independently, and typically requires close supervision on new tasks only. The candidate will be expected to maintain all environments by performing tasks such as installing upgrades, monitoring system performance, troubleshooting issues and providing support for continuous testing activities ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Support Magnit's multiple upcoming capital projects. Perform environment refreshes. Streamline the environment refresh process. Apply People Soft PUMs to required environments Monitor and maintain all People Soft delivered architecture components. Support People Soft Integration Broker Assist in any n Vision issues encountered by our business team Analyze and complete all migrations of internal/external People Soft objects Monitor and maintain external/internal interface components (FTP, files, services, etc.) People Soft Internet Architecture components including Application server, Web server and process Scheduler Works with DBAs, Network Engineers, Server administrators and Developers as needed Security support for Peoplesoft 9.2 and People Tools 8.61. Perform requirements gathering and preparation of technical specifications/documentation for upgrades, conversions and/or transition projects. Ensure the timely delivery and expected functionality of project initiatives. SKILLS: Extensive experience in People Soft Systems, Security, Database & OS administration supporting People Soft HCM, FSCM & IH applications across 9.2/8.58 versions. Experience with SQL Experience in and thorough knowledge of the software development processes (SDLC) Extensive experience (prefer 5+ years' experience) in and thorough understanding of: Troubleshooting and maintaining People Soft Internet Architecture components including Application server, Web server and process Scheduler People Soft Security framework and able to manage day-to-day security access requests setting up Users, Roles, Permission Lists, Query/object security, Integration Broker security, Report Security and Business Unit, Row Level & User Preferences Security. This includes Peoplesoft Security audit reporting. Portal, SSO, AD/LDAP setup and should be able to troubleshoot any sign on related issues. Integration Broker setup/configuration as well as handling integration issues between People Soft to People Soft and People Soft to third-party Applications. People Soft Database /Oracle database administration / Web Logic administration Tuning Performance issues across different tiers of People Soft Application, Process Scheduler, Web, Integration Gateway and Database Servers. Tuning online and Batch performance issues. Working on maintenance of latest version of People Soft Applications (HCM, FSCM, and IH), People Soft Internet Architecture (Oracle DB, Tuxedo, Web Logic, IIS) and related utilities including COBOL, STAT, Crystal/BI Publisher, n Vision, Clean Address, etc. Installing, configuring and setting up People Soft applications ground up. Installing PUM demos, extracting DPK Change Packages, patches, updates/fixes and applying them using Change Assistant. Designing strategies and implementing Clustering, load balancing and failover across all layers of PIA including Web, Integration Gateway, Application and Process Scheduler Servers. Migration of other People Soft interface components including Self-service/benefits portal, n Vision, BI Publisher, and third-party dependent apps. Must have a proven ability to work independently, as well as to function as a participating team member. Experience in quickly gathering and analyzing information to make timely and appropriate decisions on system issues. Strong oral, written, and presentation communication skills. Proven ability to concurrently manage multiple assignments of a diverse nature. Ability to complete assigned tasks on time is required. EXPERIENCE People Soft HCM 9.2, FSCM 9.2, IH 9.1 with People Tools 8.60+ running on Oracle Linux x86-64 V. 6-7, Windows 10, Server 2012-2019 Oracle Database 19c+ Web Logic 11g/12c, Tuxedo 11g/12c, Apache, VMware 9.2 PUM, DPK, CA, Upgrade & Security Specialist People Tools utilities, including n Vision, Crystal, BI Publisher, etc. Visual COBOL, Clean Address, etc. Jira Cloud Ticketing

jobDescription: Software Engineer – AI/ML (3+ Years Experience) About the Role We are building next-generation AI-powered platforms that leverage Large Language Models (LLMs), Machine Learning (ML), NLP, and agentic workflows to automate critical business processes across multiple domains. As a Software Engineer, you will work within our AI/ML team to design, build, and ship production-grade AI features with moderate guidance, while mentoring junior engineers and contributing to architectural decisions. This role is suited for engineers with 3+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML who are ready to take greater ownership of features and systems. Responsibilities Design, develop, and deploy AI/ML workflows and models with minimal supervision. Build and maintain robust APIs and backend services powering AI-driven applications. Train, fine-tune, and evaluate ML models for tasks such as classification, prediction, and ranking, and iterate based on performance metrics. Work hands-on with LLMs (Open AI, Claude, Gemini) to build prompt engineering strategies, RAG pipelines, and agentic workflows for real business use cases. Own document processing pipelines involving OCR, data extraction, and ML-based validation, and improve their accuracy and reliability. Integrate AI models with external systems via well-designed APIs, handling error cases, scaling, and observability. Write clean, tested, and maintainable code, and participate in code reviews for peers and junior engineers. Actively participate in agile sprints, technical design discussions, and architecture reviews, contributing your own proposals. Troubleshoot and debug issues across the ML/AI stack, from data pipelines to model outputs to API integrations. Mentor associate/junior engineers and support their onboarding and skill development. Document processes, decisions, and learnings, and contribute to team-wide knowledge sharing and best practices. Required Skills Strong proficiency in Python, with solid software engineering fundamentals (clean code, version control, testing). Practical experience with ML frameworks such as Tensor Flow, Py Torch, or scikit-learn, including model training and evaluation. Hands-on experience with NLP techniques (text classification, summarization, embeddings, information extraction). Working experience with LLM-based development — prompt engineering, RAG architectures, or agentic frameworks (e.g., Lang Chain, Llama Index, or similar). Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and system design fundamentals. Experience building and consuming REST/Graph QL APIs, and integrating third-party or internal services. Working knowledge of databases (SQL/No SQL) and data modeling for ML pipelines. Practical exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for deploying and scaling ML/AI workloads. Familiarity with MLOps practices — model versioning, monitoring, CI/CD for ML — is a plus. Exposure to containerization (Docker) and orchestration basics (Kubernetes) is a plus. Mindset We Are Looking For Ownership: Comfortable owning features end-to-end, from design through deployment and monitoring. Problem-solving: Able to independently debug, experiment, and land solutions under ambiguity. Curiosity: Genuinely excited about Gen AI, ML, and staying current with fast-evolving tools and techniques. Collaboration & mentorship: Works well with architects and seniors, while guiding junior team members. Pragmatism: Balances speed, quality, and scalability when shipping AI features to production. Growth mindset: Continuously sharpens technical depth in AI/ML while broadening system-level thinking. Build agent harnesses, reusable agent skills/tools, and MCP servers as the standard tool and integration layer between models and our systems, APIs, and data. Architect RAG systems (including Graph RAG) that ground outputs in trusted data, and event-driven pipelines that trigger and coordinate agents at scale. Productize agents end-to-end with guardrails, confidence-score-based routing, human-in-the-loop state machines, evaluation harnesses, tracing, and circuit breakers. Embed responsible-AI practices (privacy, bias mitigation, and auditability) directly into the reasoning and execution loops. Set architecture and code-quality standards, run design and code reviews, and mentor engineers; steer teams toward the right technologies and away from hype-driven choices. Make pragmatic build/buy decisions across frameworks, model providers, and orchestration patterns, balancing reliability, latency, security, and cost. Build with AI coding tools and AI-assisted development to raise team velocity and quality, with disciplined review gates. What You'll Bring 10+ years in software engineering, with a strong track record shipping production Saa S and large-scale, cloud-native distributed systems (AWS, GCP, or Azure). 5+ years in technical leadership (Staff / Principal / Lead / Architect) driving cross-team decisions and mentoring engineers. Hands-on experience building Gen AI applications: LLMs, prompt and context engineering, embeddings, vector databases, and RAG. Proven experience designing and shipping agentic AI systems: multi-agent orchestration, tool/function calling, agentic loops, memory, and autonomous execution, both embedded in a product and standalone. Depth in AI productization: guardrails, confidence-based logic, human-in-the-loop control, evaluation, observability, and reliability of agents in production. Experience building MCP servers (or equivalent tool layers), reusable agent skills, and event-driven architectures. Strong Python plus one of Go, Java, or Type Script; fluency with modern AI and agent frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Lang Chain, Crew AI, Auto Gen). Practical experience building products with AI coding tools. Working knowledge of responsible AI: privacy, bias, and auditability. Nice to Have Building, fine-tuning, and deploying Small Language Models (SLMs) for routing, extraction, classification, and tool-calling, including on-device/edge and privacy-sensitive deployments. MLOps / LLMOps experience and observability/tracing stacks (e.g., Open Telemetry). Open-source contributions, patents, or publications in AI. MS or Ph D in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field (or equivalent experience). - Financial Operation • Partner with Financial Operations Analyst of assigned account(s) to ensure all deliverables are provided on time, errors resolved, and financial objectives are met while maintaining quality of work. • Timesheet adjustments in Magnit's Vendor Management System (VMS), other VMS and Magnit's ERP system, People Soft, to provide support to colleagues in the Financial Operations team to help them to provide accurate and quality invoices for the clients. • Responsible for invoice creation, report generation/ creation, and data entry.• Maintaining all entries with a high standard of accuracy and attention to detail for various ad hoc and recurring data entry tasks.• Reconcile data between VMS and ERP (People Soft).• Co-ordinated with various members of the Financial Operations team to action and ad hoc administrative requests and support tasks as needed.• Oversee the end-to-end accounts receivable process, ensuring accurate and timelyinvoicing. • Monitor outstanding invoices and follow up with clients to ensure on-time payments. International Agent of Payment (AOP) data coordination and relationship management. Update payroll records as requested by client, employee or client services. Ad hoc reporting
- producing basic reporting on departments, workers, vendors etc. Evaluate processes and procedural documents for increased efficiencies and opportunities for improvement. Experience with payroll processing systems, preferably People Soft or similar large-scale ERP. Ability to troubleshoot and resolve customer complaints using pre-defined and creative solutions. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, and diagram or schedule form. Intermediate knowledge of Microsoft Office Products, specifically Excel, Word and Power Point. jobDescription: The Senior Accountant will be a hands‑on contributor focused on strengthening internal controls and improving financial processes across the organization. This role is responsible for evaluating workflows, assessing control effectiveness, identifying risks, and recommending practical process and control enhancements. The Senior Accountant will analyze transactions and trends, monitor control activities, support internal and external audit requests, and maintain clear and accurate control documentation. Success in this role requires clear written and verbal communication skills, responsiveness to internal and external stakeholders, and the ability to collaborate cross‑functionally. The ideal candidate is detail‑oriented, adaptable, and accountable, with the ability to manage priorities effectively and deliver high‑quality work in a dynamic environment. Design, document, and implement process and control enhancements to improve efficiency, accuracy, and consistency. Perform detailed account analyses, reconciliations, flux reviews, and transaction monitoring to ensure compliance with established accounting policies and control requirements. Support internal and external audit activities, including preparing documentation, responding to inquiries, and assisting with remediation efforts. Prepare and maintain internal control documentation, including control matrices, flow charts, narratives, procedures, and related governance materials. Assess control impacts of process changes, system updates, and new business initiatives. Support ongoing control monitoring and continuous improvement efforts to strengthen the overall control environment. Collaborate cross‑functionally and across regions to align processes, document and strengthen controls, and support better decision‑making. Clearly document processes, controls, and findings, and communicate recommendations effectively to stakeholders.
